en.headline: Public hospitals record 26 serious medication errors in first quarter
en.dek: The Hospital Authority said the figure rose more than 70 per cent from the previous quarter, with anticoagulants involved in 12 cases.
body: Hong Kong's public hospitals recorded 26 serious untoward events involving medication errors in the first quarter of 2026, the Hospital Authority said in its latest Risk Alert bulletin published on Friday.

The number was 11 higher than the 15 cases reported in the fourth quarter of 2025, representing a rise of more than 70 per cent. Of the 26 incidents, 12 involved anticoagulants, five involved insulin or oral diabetes drugs, and one concerned medication prescribed to a patient with a known allergy.

The authority also reported seven sentinel events during the quarter, including three cases of retained instruments or material after surgery, three procedures involving the wrong body part, and one inpatient suicide. The bulletin shares lessons and recommendations to enhance patient safety.

zh.headline: 公院首季錄26宗嚴重藥物錯誤事件
zh.dek: 醫管局指數字較上一季上升逾七成，其中12宗涉及抗凝血藥。
body: 醫管局星期五在最新一期《風險通報》公布，本港公立醫院於2026年第一季錄得26宗涉及藥物錯誤的嚴重突發事件。
數字較2025年第四季的15宗增加11宗，升幅逾七成。26宗事件中，12宗涉及抗凝血藥，5宗涉及胰島素或口服糖尿藥，1宗則關乎向已知過敏病人處方藥物。
醫管局同期亦錄得7宗哨兵事件，包括3宗手術後遺留儀器或物料、3宗涉及錯誤身體部位的程序，以及1宗住院病人自殺。通報分享經驗及建議，以加強病人安全。
